prompt: Vertical 9:16 amateur night snapshot on cheap colour film, from the pavement looking in through the open glass door of a British corner shop. The shop is nearly dark now: one flickering tube at the back and the glow of a drinks fridge. On the rubber doormat a wire spinner rack has turned to face the door. A handwritten paper sign taped to the glass reads "BREAD £5", the £1 beneath it scribbled out. The inner door has swung half shut on its own. Deep murky teal-black, the fridge light blooming, coarse grain, soft focus, underexposed, slightly skewed. Nobody there. No brands, nothing staged or digital. Thanks.
